pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: A decoded Cave Codex and its matching map guide the search. Magnetic Caves, Primordial Caves, Toxic Caves, Abyssal Chasm, Forlorn Hollows or Candy Cavity each qualify; five further visits are not required.
